newsitem.title: USA: Marine Midland completes purchase of N.Y. thrift.
newsitem.headline: Marine Midland completes purchase of N.Y. thrift.

text.p: Marine Midland Bank, a unit of HSBC Americas Inc, said Tuesday it has completed its $620 million deal to acquire First Federal Savings and Loan Assocation of Rochester, effective March 1.
Approval to complete the acquisition was received from New York banking regulators on February 13 and from the Federal Reserve Board on February 3, it said.
Plans call for First Federal branches and offices to be converted to Marine Midland systems by August, it said.

Marine Midland is the principal U.S. subsidiary of HSBC Americas, which is a unit of HSBC Holdings Plc. HSBC Americas had nearly $24 billion in assets and more than 325 branches throughout the state of New York at year-end 1996.
First Federal had $7.1 billion in assets at year-end 1996. It had 79 retail branches in New York state and 15 mortgage-lending offices in nine states.
Marine Midland purchased First Federal from CT Financial Services Inc, of Toronto.
